use_case_summary: Serephon builds an agent assist + post-call summary product for mid-market telco customers. Primary goals: generate concise post-call transcripts, automated QA notes (score + flags), coaching highlight clips, and create ticket drafts for CRM. Needs reliable performance under call spikes and deterministic cost model for committed customers.
requirements_summary: Key requirements: p95 latency target ~<450ms per token for agent assist; end-to-end summary generation <3s for 2-3 minute calls; scalable throughput to handle burst 4x baseline; prefix/KV caching to reduce repeated context cost; function/tool-calling to trigger CRM ticket creation and extract entities; SSO + SAML, audit logging, EU data residency option, KMS integration for keys. Prefer dedicated pools for production but willing to pilot on hosted API for speed to first result.
